entries.zh: 在；居于某处；另附“第”的序数用法（1°、2°）
entries.en: at, in; to be at (a place); also the ordinal prefix tē: 1st, 2nd
entries.notes: L、M 两栏均带[残][疑]且拼合痕明显，仅凭 H“在”与 M 末段“tey it”（第一）、R“tey:1°2°”推定为“在”兼“第”序数。

entries.en: beforehand, in advance; first (in time)
entries.notes: M 栏仅一字母“v”，当是以 v 记 u 音（預 ū），非残损，故释义仍依 H“預”与 L“primero（先）”。

entries.en: first; first in rank or dignity
the first day of the year; New Year's Day
before, in front; former, earlier

entries.zh: 监生（国子监生员，科举初级功名）
entries.en: jiansheng, student of the Imperial College; the first mandarin degree
entries.notes: H 仅存“監”，M 次音“seuy”疑即“生”之讹或残迹，参第 13 条“監生 cam seng”定夺。

entries.en: first in the provincial examination (short for jieyuan); head of the degree list
entries.notes: H 止一字“解”，L“primero en licencia（科名之首）”促定为“解元”之省，非“解送”义。

entries.zh: 武状元（武科殿试第一名）
entries.en: first place in the military metropolitan examination; military zhuangyuan
top of the list; first on the roll
entries.notes: R 栏“gung siui”与 H“榜首”音不合，疑为另一方音或误记，释义依 H 与 M“pong siu”。

entries.en: jieyuan, first place in the provincial examination
entries.notes: M 栏“cay”重出（三音对二字），疑抄写重复，不影响 H/L 互证。

entries.en: head of the row or line; first in order
first (ordinal); number one
jiansheng, student of the Imperial College
entries.notes: L 栏“primero, primera mᵗᵉ”（=primeramente 首先）与 H“監生”义不合，疑 L 与 H 栏错位，释义依 H/M/R。

entries.en: beforehand, previously; in the first place
the first day of the (lunar) month

entries.zh: 初旬；上旬（每月初一至初十）
entries.en: the first ten days of the month; the early part of the month
from the beginning; all along; formerly
originally; at first; formerly

entries.zh: 品第；等级次序（“第品”即品级之序）
entries.en: rank, grade; order of precedence; first in rank
entries.notes: “第品”非经见常词，M“tey pin”亦可读为“品第”之倒，义从 L“primero en dignidad”定为止首位次。

entries.en: first cousin (male); cousin-brothers on the maternal side
cousin; cousin on the father's side; second cousin
